data.architecture: Pinned LatentMDGenModel;256hidden,4latent layers,4prependIPA layers,8MHAheads,64frames,4residues; absolute residue/time embeddings
data.loss: Official GVP-path velocity Flow Matching; Adam1e-4, grad norm clip1; FP32

variants.framewise: zero temporal-attention branch outputs via hooks; same parameter containers and first-frame IPA conditioning

data.evaluation: Fixed validation flow loss selects best; final short-clip torsion histograms,autocorrelation,peptide-bond geometry,keyframe RMSD; test reserved
data.limits: Small feasibility study; not published full-dataset replication, not calibrated drug-discovery oracle. Six trials20k updates each; no statistical significance claim from2validation peptides.

data.invariant: A block mean of unit quaternions or valid sine/cosine pairs must have norm<=1. Generated latent feasibility is checked before decoder projection.
data.density_scope: Training-only linear conditional centering and16D residualPCA; diagnostics, not a true conditional likelihood. Nearer training residuals can also mean underdispersion, not better generation.
data.normalization_scope: Quaternion and angle-pair renormalization proxy, not a complete atom14 encode/decode cycle.

data.purpose: Test full-model context robustness and prior-scale calibration after diagnostics of contracted slow distributions; neither is a proven fix.
data.training: all slow and fast parameters, fresh identical AdamW in each short arm
data.context_scope: Training-only detached one-step endpoint error, clipped at0.1 normalized RMS, applied50% of clips to previous-slow and fast-condition. Initial state and flow targets remain exact. No actual long on-policy histories; partial robustness intervention.
data.prior_scope: Gaussian slow prior scaled1.1 in training AND generation with matched flow target; no manual rescaling of generated physical coordinates. Exact flow can in principle preserve target distribution; observed benefit requires validation.
data.validation: All32 molecules, same fixed clips/noise per arm on H200. Deterministic teacher loss and free rollout. Selected winner confirmed once on second development clips/noise; test untouched.
